# birthday-page
李蕎安公主生日快樂網頁
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-Hant">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>李蕎安公主 生日快樂 👑</title>
<style>
:root{box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0}
body{min-height:100vh;background:linear-gradient(170deg,#ffe3ef 0%,#fff0f7 45%,#ffe9c9 100%);color:#7a2f52;font-family:"Noto Sans TC","PingFang TC","Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif;text-align:center;overflow-x:hidden}
.screen{display:none;position:relative;z-index:1;padding:28px 16px 40px;min-height:100vh;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.screen.on{display:flex}
.float{position:fixed;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;bottom:-40px;animation:up linear infinite;opacity:.8}
@keyframes up{to{transform:translateY(-115vh) rotate(40deg)}}
#bg{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden}
#bg::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(170deg,#ffe3efcc,#fff0f799 50%,#ffe9c9cc)}
#bg .ph{position:absolute;width:clamp(110px,34vw,200px);padding:5px 5px 18px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 4px 12px #0003;border-radius:3px;transform:rotate(var(--r));animation:sway 6s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
#bg .ph img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/4;object-fit:cover;display:block}
@keyframes sway{to{transform:rotate(var(--r)) translateY(-10px)}}
.crown{font-size:70px;animation:b 1.2s infinite alternate}
@keyframes b{to{transform:translateY(-12px) rotate(6deg)}}
h1{font-size:clamp(30px,8.5vw,50px);margin:6px 0;line-height:1.25;color:#e8457f;text-shadow:2px 2px 0 #fff,0 0 18px #ffc2da}
h2{font-size:26px;margin:4px 0;color:#e8457f}
p{font-size:17px;margin:8px 0 20px;line-height:1.6;background:#ffffffb8;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:14px}
button{font:inherit;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(#ff7aa8,#ff4f8b);border:3px solid #fff;border-radius:999px;padding:13px 34px;box-shadow:0 6px 0 #d63d74,0 10px 20px #ff4f8b55;cursor:pointer}
button:active{transform:translateY(4px);box-shadow:0 2px 0 #d63d74}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:14px;max-width:420px;width:100%;margin-top:10px}
.ticket{position:relative;aspect-ratio:3/4;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;border:3px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 6px 16px #d6458f44}
.prize{visibility:hidden;position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;padding:8px 8px 6px;gap:3px;background:#fff8fb}
.prize .ico{font-size:58px;margin-top:14px}
.prize{justify-content:center}
.prize .rank{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#ff4f8b;margin-top:3px}
.prize .name{font-size:16px;font-weight:700}
.prize .desc{font-size:12px;line-height:1.3}
canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;touch-action:none;cursor:crosshair;transition:opacity .6s}
#msg{background:#ffffffb8;padding:6px 14px;border-radius:14px;min-height:28px;font-weight:700;font-size:18px;margin-top:18px;color:#e8457f}
#fin{display:none;margin-top:6px}
.list{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:8px 0 18px;font-size:16px;line-height:1.9}
#fx{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:9}

/* ===== 單張挑選模式 ===== */
.grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
.ticket{cursor:pointer;transition:transform .25s ease,box-shadow .25s ease}
.ticket:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 10px 24px #d6458f55}
.ticket.done{opacity:.48;filter:saturate(.55)}<section class="screen" id="s2">
  <h2>👑 公主專屬生日一番賞</h2>
  <p style="margin:2px 0 6px">先選一張卡片，點下去就會放大到中間刮開！💝</p>
  <div class="grid" id="grid"></div>
  <div id="msg">請選一張你最想刮的卡片 ✨</div>
  <button id="fin">💌 打開最後的驚喜</button>
</section>

<div id="cardModal">
  <div id="modalBox">
    <div id="modalHint">✨ 刮開這一張看看！</div>
    <div id="bigTicket"></div>
    <button id="backBtn">↩️ 刮完了，回去選下一張</button>
  </div>
</div>
<section class="screen" id="s3">
  <div class="crown">💖</div>
  <h1>李蕎安公主<br>全部刮完啦！</h1>
  <ul class="list" id="list"></ul>
  <p style="font-size:19px;font-weight:700;color:#e8457f">謝謝你出現在我的生活裡 🥹<br>生日快樂，我最愛的皇上！❤️</p>
  <button id="again">🎟️ 回去看看卡片</button>
</section>

<script>

const COVER = new Image(); COVER.src = "data:image/jpeg;base64,";

const PRIZES = [
  {rank:"A賞", ico:"🎁", name:"男友精心挑選精美禮物", desc:"最用心挑選的專屬好禮"},
  {rank:"B賞", ico:"🧸", name:"蕎安本人玩偶", desc:"一個地方有兩個皇上"},
  {rank:"C賞", ico:"💣", name:"男朋友手作炸彈", desc:"親手做的，男朋友用它破破爛爛的手盡力了💥"},
  {rank:"D賞", ico:"💌", name:"精美掉小珍珠小卡片", desc:"散裝國文的小情書👉👈 ✨"},
  {rank:"E賞", ico:"😘", name:"男朋友親一個", desc:"👉👈 能現在就兌換嗎 我想要湊五個禮物的👉👈"}
];

const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const state = { done:new Set(), current:-1 };

function showScreen(id){
  document.querySelectorAll(".screen").forEach(s=>s.classList.remove("on"));
  $(id).classList.add("on");
}

function buildPrizeHTML(p){
  return `<div class="prize">
    <div class="ico">${p.ico}</div>
    <div class="rank">${p.rank}</div>
    <div class="name">${p.name}</div>
    <div class="desc">${p.desc}</div>
  </div>`;
}

function makeScratch(canvas, onFinish){
  const ctx=canvas.getContext("2d");
  let drawing=false, done=false, lastX=0, lastY=0;
  function resize(){
    const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const d=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,2);
    canvas.width=Math.max(1,Math.round(r.width*d));
    canvas.height=Math.max(1,Math.round(r.height*d));
    ctx.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);
    const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,r.width,r.height);
    g.addColorStop(0,"#c7c7c7"); g.addColorStop(.5,"#f0f0f0"); g.addColorStop(1,"#a9a9a9");
    ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,r.width,r.height);
    ctx.fillStyle="#777"; ctx.font="700 28px sans-serif"; ctx.textAlign="center";
    ctx.fillText("刮開看看 🎟️",r.width/2,r.height/2);
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation="destination-out";
  }
  function point(e){
    const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const t=e.touches ? e.touches[0] : e;
    return [t.clientX-r.left,t.clientY-r.top];
  }
  function scratch(e){
    if(!drawing||done) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const [x,y]=point(e);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(lastX,lastY); ctx.lineTo(x,y);
    ctx.lineWidth=42; ctx.lineCap="round"; ctx.lineJoin="round"; ctx.stroke();
    lastX=x; lastY=y;
  }
  function start(e){
    if(done)return;
    drawing=true; [lastX,lastY]=point(e); scratch(e);
  }
  function end(){
    if(!drawing)return;
    drawing=false;
    const w=canvas.width, h=canvas.height;
    try{
      const data=ctx.getImageData(0,0,w,h).data;
      let transparent=0;
      for(let i=3;i<data.length;i+=4) if(data[i]<60) transparent++;
      if(transparent/(w*h)>.55 && !done){
        done=true; canvas.style.opacity="0";
        setTimeout(()=>onFinish(),450);
      }
    }catch(_){
      // If pixel inspection is blocked, user can still reveal by enough scratching.
    }
  }
  canvas.addEventListener("mousedown",start);
  canvas.addEventListener("mousemove",scratch);
  window.addEventListener("mouseup",end);
  canvas.addEventListener("touchstart",start,{passive:false});
  canvas.addEventListener("touchmove",scratch,{passive:false});
  window.addEventListener("touchend",end,{passive:false});
  resize();
  return {resize};
}

function renderGrid(){
  const grid=$("grid");
  grid.innerHTML="";
  PRIZES.forEach((p,i)=>{
    const ticket=document.createElement("div");
    ticket.className="ticket"+(state.done.has(i)?" done":"");
    ticket.innerHTML=buildPrizeHTML(p)+`<div style="position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:56px;z-index:1">🎟️</div>`;
    if(state.done.has(i)){
      ticket.querySelector(".prize").style.visibility="visible";
      ticket.querySelector("div[style]").textContent="✨";
    } else {
      ticket.addEventListener("click",()=>openCard(i));
    }
    grid.appendChild(ticket);
  });
  $("msg").textContent = state.done.size===PRIZES.length
    ? "五張都刮完啦！可以打開最後的驚喜 💖"
    : `還有 ${PRIZES.length-state.done.size} 張卡片，選一張來刮吧！`;
  $("fin").style.display=state.done.size===PRIZES.length?"inline-block":"none";
}

function openCard(i){
  state.current=i;
  const modal=$("cardModal"), big=$("bigTicket");
  big.innerHTML=buildPrizeHTML(PRIZES[i]);
  const c=document.createElement("canvas");
  big.appendChild(c);
  modal.classList.add("on");
  $("modalHint").textContent=`第 ${i+1} 張｜慢慢刮開看看 ✨`;
  const scratcher=makeScratch(c,()=>finishCard(i));
  window.addEventListener("resize",()=>{
    if(modal.classList.contains("on")) scratcher.resize();
  },{once:true});
}

function finishCard(i){
  state.done.add(i);
  $("modalHint").textContent=`🎉 刮開了！${PRIZES[i].name}`;
  $("msg").textContent="看完獎品後，按下面按鈕回去選下一張 💝";
}

$("backBtn").addEventListener("click",()=>{
  $("cardModal").classList.remove("on");
  state.current=-1;
  renderGrid();
});

$("go").addEventListener("click",()=>{
  showScreen("s2");
  renderGrid();
});

$("fin").addEventListener("click",()=>{
  $("list").innerHTML=PRIZES.map((p,i)=>`<li>${i+1}. ${p.ico} ${p.name} — ${p.desc}</li>`).join("");
  showScreen("s3");
});

$("again").addEventListener("click",()=>{
  showScreen("s2");
  renderGrid();
});

// 背景照片（維持原本的 COVER）
COVER.onload=()=>{
  const bg=$("bg");
  for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
    const ph=document.createElement("div");
    ph.className="ph";
    ph.style.left=(5+i*16)+"%";
    ph.style.top=(8+(i%3)*28)+"%";
    ph.style.setProperty("--r",(-8+i*3)+"deg");
    const im=document.createElement("img");
    im.src=COVER.src;
    ph.appendChild(im); bg.appendChild(ph);
  }
};

// 小愛心特效
(function(){
  const fx=$("fx"),ctx=fx.getContext("2d"),items=[];
  function resize(){fx.width=innerWidth;fx.height=innerHeight}
  addEventListener("resize",resize); resize();
  function add(){
    items.push({x:Math.random()*fx.width,y:fx.height+20,s:10+Math.random()*14,v:1+Math.random()*2,a:1});
  }
  function loop(){
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,fx.width,fx.height);
    if(Math.random()<.12)add();
    for(let i=items.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const q=items[i]; q.y-=q.v; q.a-=.003;
      ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,q.a); ctx.font=q.s+"px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("💗",q.x,q.y);
      if(q.a<=0||q.y<-30)items.splice(i,1);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha=1; requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  loop();
})();

renderGrid();
</script>
</body>
</html>
